name: GBIF Data
description: Fetch georeferenced GBIF occurrence records by map view, layer extent, country or worldwide, with backbone taxon search, major groups, record type, year range, photo, IUCN Red List, coordinate-uncertainty, licence and dataset filters, a live match counter, GBIF density tiles, a record popup and citation tools (dataset list for a derived-dataset DOI). Independent plugin, not affiliated with GBIF.
